description: This file implements state handling logic for a lifecycle manager in a plugin-based framework, including methods for handling different lifecycle states such as loading, initializing, pausing, active, suspending, hibernating, and terminating. It interacts with runtime and window manager handlers, manages application context, and uses Boost UUIDs for generating unique IDs.

classes.name: UnloadedState
classes.description: Represents the unloaded state of the application lifecycle, with a handle method that always returns true.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Represents the loading state, responsible for generating a new application instance ID and signaling loading completion.

classes.name: InitializingState
classes.description: Handles application initialization by invoking the runtime manager's run method and setting pending events.

classes.name: PausedState
classes.description: Handles pausing, including suspending or resuming display rendering based on current lifecycle state.

classes.name: ActiveState
classes.description: Handles the active state, ensuring the application's render is ready and signaling when the first frame is available.

classes.name: SuspendedState
classes.description: Handles suspension, including waking from hibernation or disabling display rendering.

classes.name: HibernatedState
classes.description: Handles hibernation by invoking the runtime handler's hibernate method.

classes.name: TerminatingState
classes.description: Handles application termination, either forcefully killing or gracefully terminating via the runtime handler, and sets pending events.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles state-specific logic for each lifecycle state, interacting with runtime and window managers, managing application context, and signaling state transitions.
